shared: Gold carries over, so the Hive grows on gold you keep and the Carnival on gold you spend.
differ: How gold pays out: a little every 3 coins, all-or-nothing turns, or a different number per card.

takes.label: Every coin pays twice
takes.line: Every 3 gold saved fires Thrift, every 3 spent fires Spree, so both towns grow each turn; Shell Masks swap triggers between towns.
takes.look_if: a slow winter build-up, then one huge 30-gold summer turn

takes.label: Save, then splurge
takes.line: A strict two-turn rhythm: end with gold left for Hoard, then spend double your income to Splurge; Gate Guard stings for your whole bank.
takes.look_if: a clear on-off rhythm, with your saved gold used as a weapon

takes.label: Balancing the books
takes.line: Two counters, Spent and Purse, with a different trigger number on each card; Ottavia pays for keeping both level, so exact sums matter.
takes.look_if: a puzzle of exact gold counts and unit order
